description: Set property values in an existing .tres resource file and save it. Properties not named, sub-resources and uids stay as the file has them. A Dictionary or Array value replaces the stored one whole; send every key. Values are checked against declared types as in set_node_properties (Property Values in docs/tools.md); one invalid name or value errors and writes nothing. Returns: resourcePath, resourceType, scriptPath, the named properties read back. Errors while a runtime session is live.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

properties.description: Property values to set, at least one, keyed by property name as written, with the same value rules as set_node_properties. script and resource_path are refused.

resourcePath.description: Path of the .tres file inside the project, e.g. "items/sword.tres".

name: set_resource_properties

properties.description: Each property the call set, read back from the saved file, in the shapes set_node_properties accepts.

resourcePath.description: Project-relative path of the .tres file written.

resourceType.description: Engine class of the saved resource (Resource for a script class).

scriptPath.description: Project-relative path of its script, or null.
